manifestations.invariant: Bundle validation reports malformed JSON before any configuration-rule error, regardless of which document contains either defect.

contract_excerpt.quote: Bundle validation parses every document before applying configuration rules. If any document is malformed JSON, the bundle result is `{"ok": false, "error": "invalid_json"}` even when an earlier document also violates a configuration rule.
